column1: # BestPath Slayer overrides: HAND-AUTHORED corrections on top of the generated data/wiki/slayer-places.tsv (never edited
# by hand). Read by the plugin export (gradlew -p tool exportPlugin, tool/.../slayer/SlayerExport). A line matches the
# place with that task row (column task of slayer-places.tsv) and place name.
# Changes: place-shift <dx>,<dy>,<plane> (every Wiki tile of the place moved by dx, dy and put on that plane before it is
# placed on the map) | skip-place - (the place is left out of the Slayer list).
